name = Arctic Armour | type = Buff | icon = Arctic Armour skill icon.png | description = You are immune to being [[Frozen]]. While stationary, you take less fire and physical damage. }} '''Arctic Armour''' is a [[spell]] that [[mana reservation|reserves mana]] to grant the caster immunity to [[freeze]], a reduction to [[physical damage|physical]] and [[fire damage]] while stationary, the ability to [[chill]] enemies that hit them, and to cause them to leave behind a trail of [[chilled ground]] while moving. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Less Damage taken when Hit''': This modifier is applied at the very end of the [[damage calculation]]s (i.e. after [[armour]] and fire [[resistance]] damage calculation). As the damage reduction is only applied on hits (including [[reflect]]), [[damage over time]] effects like [[burning]] are not affected. * '''Chilled ground''': Ground ice [[chill]]s anything standing on it. This does not stack with other chills. * [[Mana Reservation]]: Arctic Armour is affected by all mana reservation efficiency modifiers. * '''Blood Magic''': An {{il|Arrogance Support}} gem can be linked to Arctic Armour or the [[Blood Magic]] keystone can be allocated to make Arctic Armour reserve life instead of mana. * {{il|The Snowblind Grace}}: This [[unique item]] makes Arctic Armour's [[reservation]] free and increases the buff effect. * {{il|The Perfect Form}}: Legacy versions of this [[unique item]] makes Arctic Armour's [[reservation]] free. * [[Secrets of Suffering]]: When this keystone is allocated, the icy barrier can no longer chill (the chilled ground still does). ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = less
